title: Evaluating Large Language Models Against Human Annotators in Latent Content Analysis: Sentiment, Political Leaning, Emotional Intensity, and Sarcasm

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLMs' assessments of political leaning on a 1 to 5 Likert scale across curated sentences and comparing their mean ratings to human annotators to detect systemic interpretation shifts or biases.

Comparing LLM ratings of sarcasm against human baselines using statistical mean comparisons to identify systemic algorithmic tendencies (biases) towards overestimating or misinterpreting sarcastic content.
Analyzing whether LLMs systematically underreport or misrepresent emotional intensity compared to human annotators using independent sample t-tests on Likert scale ratings.
